defects.summary: Production REST/MCP retrieval output is not yet gated by server-owned deterministic claim verification; free-form consumer prose and model citation markers can exceed returned evidence.
defects.evidence: Run 003 at 4c45a23c48b7954bbfb0ab86bcc92c975f345a1f: 18 unresolvable citation-marker instances, 9 unsupported assertions, and 1 clear hallucination.

defects.summary: Runtime redirect-to-private refusal has not been demonstrated through an allowed first hop and controlled private canary.
defects.evidence: Run 003 security result: redirect-to-private NOT_PROVEN; initial loopback redirect fixture request was rejected before redirect.

defects.summary: Reference-agent campaign can continue repeated insufficient-evidence attempts until the model-turn limit rather than terminating at deterministic convergence.
defects.evidence: Run 003: OBSCURE-05, FALSE-03, and FALSE-04 reached model turn limit without a final answer.

defects.summary: Run 003 fetch failures require per-attempt failure taxonomy before any secure compatibility changes are considered.
defects.evidence: Run 003: 44/76 fetches returned documents; 32/76 returned no document/error, with failure categories not fully classified.

defects.summary: Claim-level literal support can be promoted without proving question-to-claim relevance, exact request-identifier binding, complete answer coverage, or explicitly requested source authority.
defects.evidence: Immutable Run 006 FALSE-04 attempt 02: raw evidence SHA-256 4bbc539bfb999839f6ee30a2e75bbe2e225169bc2a9dec38418d72626b71ed2f; a supported seven-digit barcode-prefix quotation was promoted for a complete thirteen-digit exact-barcode authority question.
